title: Q3 Run Manifest Live Campaign Boundary Resolution
purpose: Resolve AMB-GOV-SURF-0875 by making the boundary between RUN_MANIFEST_V1 structural constraints and living falsification campaign state explicit and enforceable.
summary: This patch resolves AMB-GOV-SURF-0875 by classifying RUN_MANIFEST_V1 as SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT_SURFACE, classifying the living falsification campaign registry as REGISTRY_STATE_AUTHORITY, and enforcing fail-closed mismatch blocking so schema conformance cannot masquerade as live campaign-state authority.
enforcement_changes_applied: Make matched role-aware authority lookup identify the exact target surface as authority_source.
Publish both surfaces in the live authority access inventory with explicit behavior descriptions.
